title: [efficiency] unique_id uses SystemTime — clock regression can overwrite queued files
description: relay_queue.rs unique_id() combines SystemTime::now().as_millis() with an AtomicU64 counter. If NTP corrects the clock backward while the queue is non-empty, a new enqueue can generate a filename with a lower timestamp, and the atomic rename will silently overwrite the existing .msg file. Fix: use a pure AtomicU64 sequence (no wall clock) or add UUID for uniqueness independent of time.
